evidence: The interim operations window of January 1996–October 2000 sits inside the same Navy surveillance program from January 1993 through April 2002. Common authors, role strata and chamber program support an earlier cut. The interim horizon and case linkage are unavailable.
Same authors, 4.3 psia protocol, 60 min preoxygenation and posture arms. The supine sample increased from 26 to 39 in the final journal article. No record crosswalk is available.
The completed Balldin study explicitly reuses 26 ambulatory Webb controls. The interim and final reports share the same control protocol and rounded DCS and VGE rates.
